k-sym-FIONA.title: Fiona the Hippo health updates
k-sym-FIONA.sourceSays: Posts from the Cincinnati Zoo account say Fiona's care team is giving her round-the-clock care, including a vibration plate to help her pass a hat she swallowed.
k-sym-FIONA.reason: Two Nov 18-19 posts from the Cincinnati Zoo account give care updates on Fiona, a public story predating the new pools; the rest are call-group shills and scanner bots.
